Settling your international employees in Paris

A relocation, a secondment, a new office: we welcome your employees and their families, and we speak their language, in English as well as French.

What we do for international groups

Your head office speaks English, the Paris landlord speaks French. We are the bridge.

Temporary housing, then long-term
An aparthotel or furnished flat for the first weeks, then an apartment suited to the length of the secondment.
A welcome on arrival
Airport transfer, keys, a tour of the neighbourhood, first groceries. Your employee is not alone on the first evening.
Family support
Schools, childcare, helping the partner settle: we prepare the arrival of the whole family.
One contact for head office, one for the ground
English with your HR and mobility teams, French with landlords and suppliers in Paris.

Questions from international groups

Do you work with companies based outside France?

Yes. Many of our clients are German, Polish and other European companies sending staff to the Paris region. We work in English and handle the French specifics for you.

Can you help us open an office in Paris?

We house and settle the team opening the office and remain their local point of contact during the first months.

Sending people to Paris? Call us.

In ten minutes we will understand your needs and tell you what we can do. In English or French, no commitment.
